notes: A new UK-wide evidence body for adaptation that the Welsh Government co-sponsors; NRW could be a stakeholder or co-lead partner, and the centre may shape Welsh adaptation evidence and pilots.
summary: UKRI and the Economic and Social Research Council opened a funding call on 1 October 2026, with Defra, DAERA, the Scottish Government and the Welsh Government, to establish an independent What Works Centre for a climate resilient UK. The centre can receive up to 21.1 million pounds, must start by 1 August 2027, and has the UK and devolved governments, including the Welsh Government, as its primary audience. The call is scheduled to close on 15 December 2026.
title: UKRI opens a call for a What Works Centre for a climate resilient UK, worth up to 21.1 million pounds, with the Welsh Government as a partner
